name: DWH Projection API

GET.note: primarily diagnostic; POST is preferred because fragment characters in raw URLs require encoding

statusCodes.400: invalid request, symbol, or projection source

rules: API does not expose storage paths or PHP class identities
projection lookup is exact and case-sensitive
source adapter is replaceable without changing projection envelope
MMDemo consumes the same API through WebEngine createDwhAdapter()
#METAMODULE:CATALOG and #SITE are implemented through the same PHP ProjectionEngine

patternDispatch.rule: exact symbols are checked before ordered dynamic symbol patterns; missing pattern match fails closed
